Update: Drill Improvements, Notifications, and Core Systems
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Today I’m releasing the update of the drilling system.
Digging is now much smoother and more responsive.
The drill feels more powerful and stable, and overall control has become more fluid and enjoyable.
These changes not only enhance the gameplay feel, but also make exploring the depths even more engaging.

🔔 We’ve also improved the notification and interface system.
New icons have been added to make information easier to read at a glance.
Inventory overload warnings now appear earlier and more clearly, helping you stay aware of your current state at all times.

I’m continuing to refine core mechanics, especially the drilling system, aiming to make it as intuitive, responsive, and satisfying as possible.

Thank you for playing my game and showing interest in the project.
There’s much more to come - I’ll be working to bring you new adventures, increased replayability, and an even more exciting and immersive experience.

notes.title: Update!
notes.notes:
Lag during levitation has been fixed - everything runs smoothly now. The controls have changed: to levitate, simply press and hold the spacebar. Levitation will stop automatically when you release the key.
The digging depth has been increased - how do you feel about it? Is it comfortable to play with this depth? Should it be reduced, or maybe even increased further?
We recommend saving your progress regularly to avoid losing it.
Please leave a review - either in the game’s Steam reviews or in the community group discussions. It really helps to know what you enjoy and what gets in the way. Thanks for reading, and have a great day!

notes.title: New Update. Deeper. Deadlier. More Profitable.
notes.notes:
Hi there!

Thank you for continuing to play my game. I truly appreciate your support and interest.
Today, I'm releasing the first part of a new update.

Here’s what’s waiting for you underground - and beyond:

- Deeper than ever: the mine now goes much deeper. But the deeper you go, the more dangerous it becomes.

- New threats: beneath the surface lies not only precious minerals… but also things far less welcoming. Stay alert.

- New upgrade system: you can now upgrade not just your tool, but your suit, protection, and even yourself.

- Smuggler’s market: find a way to establish encrypted communication - and sell your resources at much better prices. High risk, high reward.

- Portable teleporter: quick travel between two points - now fits in your pocket.

- Antenna system: upgrading your antenna increases your chances of a successful, high-profit trade. But the connection isn’t always stable...

Thanks for reading!
Wishing you a great day - and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Achievements have been added to the game
notes.notes:
You can now earn rewards for various actions and accomplishments. I hope they bring even more excitement and enjoyment to your gameplay experience.

In the near future, I plan to release an expanded version of the game. It will be bigger, deeper, and more engaging - with more features, content, and plenty of nice little additions. I’m already working on the update and will do my best to deliver it to you as soon as possible.

notes.title: New energy balance
notes.notes: Reduced energy consumption of some tools for more comfortable gameplay. Don't forget to save, save point on the wall.

notes.title: Big Update Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I want to say a huge thank you to each and every one of you - for playing the game, sharing your impressions, leaving reviews, and helping it grow. Everything you write truly matters - your ideas and feedback are incredibly valuable and help shape the future of the project.

Right now, I’m hard at work on a major update that will open a new chapter in the game’s development. You can expect improved animations, reworked 3D models, refined tools, a more flexible and deeper progression system, achievements, and many other enhancements. I’m also expanding the gameplay itself - it’s going to become deeper, richer, and more engaging.

New mechanics, unique discoveries, and a few surprises are on the way.

My current focus is on making the game not just technically better, but also more atmospheric and exciting - with elements of exploration, hidden secrets, and new opportunities for every player.

If you have ideas, suggestions, or simply want to share what you’d like to see in the future - please feel free to leave a comment or review. Your voice means a lot to me!

See you soon ;)

notes.title: Graphics Update: Color Correction and Post-Processing
notes.notes: I’ve updated the visual side of the game: improved color correction and added post-processing effects. Digging is now even more enjoyable. Check it out and let me know what you think!
